question: Should maintainers refresh and land this PR as the canonical no-dispatch fix for the cron self-debug leak, or require live Telegram proof first?
rationale: The code shape matches prior maintainer guidance, but the branch is dirty against current main and the user-visible delivery behavior changes for a production cron/Telegram path.

options.title: Refresh And Review
options.body: Rebase or merge current main, preserve the newer cron delivery/session cleanup behavior, rerun focused validation, and proceed with maintainer review.

options.title: Require Telegram Proof First
options.body: Hold merge until Mantis or equivalent live Telegram evidence shows the self-debug text is not sent to the target topic.

options.title: Pause For Replacement
options.body: Pause this branch only if maintainers want a narrower replacement branch to carry the same structured bypass contract on current main.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Review
recommendation.body: Rebase or merge current main, preserve the newer cron delivery/session cleanup behavior, rerun focused validation, and proceed with maintainer review.
